parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to view the details of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters in the destination region. The details include the cluster ID.

sub_parameters.name: ExceedMemoryException
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether to configure a memory overflow exception.

sub_parameters.name: GroupName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the source resource group.

sub_parameters.name: QueryTime
sub_parameters.description: The execution duration of the SQL statement. Unit: milliseconds (ms).

sub_parameters.name: TargetGroupName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the target resource group.
